correctness.rationale: For A_n, the class kernel q^(n-c(g)) has central Fourier scalar Q_lambda(q)=[P_lambda(q)+P_lambda(-q)]/2 via sign-averaging the classical Frobenius hook-content product. For q<1/m, matching negative-content magnitudes to positive first-row contents forces Q>0. At q=1/j, Schur–Weyl gives a normalized tensor-permutation character, so PSD; self-conjugate hooks inside A_(2k+3) give a negative scalar on (1/(k+1),1/k), excluding all gaps. At reciprocals, missing diagrams have both first row and first column exceeding j; dimensions give stated rank and endpoint nullities. Independently enumerated partitions and exact rational Fourier scalar signs for n=3..10 and q multiples 1/60; all agreed, but the finite sign grid is not the infinite proof.
